description: Shared Rust/WASM vector for the command builders' no-program refusal (#376). Every case is a line the core must refuse instead of building a record: `code` is CommandError::code (the WASM error's `kind`) and `message` is the core's Display text. `builder` is `posix` (action_from_command) or `powershell` (action_from_powershell_command). Written by hand from docs/policy-seam.md §Command lines that run no program; never regenerate it from program output.
